acceptanceCriteria: Each group contains tickets with pairwise-disjoint changed paths, apart from declared shared paths.
A dry chained merge confirms each group, and a conflict splits the group.
The repository gains no objects and no refs.
The maximum group size is configurable.
An unresolvable candidate is reported and left ungrouped.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1023 (owner, 2026-10-17). Several tickets are often ready for a final run on the same scarce environment. Proposal: a read-only 'plan batches' verb that groups candidate tickets by pairwise-disjoint changed paths (apart from declared shared paths), confirms each group with a dry chained merge that adds no objects or refs to the repository, splits a group on conflict, has a configurable maximum group size, and reports unresolvable candidates ungrouped. Groups can share one pool allocation and run.
title: Tasks plan batches: group ready tickets with disjoint changes, confirmed by a dry chained merge (GitHub #1023)
